title: Allow anyone to upload Image Memories using phone gallery or Google Drive picker

requirements.text: Update backend image publishing/clearing authorization so that ANY caller (including non-admin users) can publish and clear Image Memory slots (images index 0–42 / UI slots 1–43), without requiring the image-uploader allowlist. Keep Hero background, Video Memory slots, and Background Song admin-only.

quotes: Give the access to anyone that they can add their images in this website through their phone gallery or Google drive

acceptanceCriteria: A non-admin principal can successfully call setImage(index, name, blob) and clearImage(index) for valid indices 0–42.
If an image index is out of range (>= 43), the backend still rejects with an 'Invalid image index' error.
Non-admin principals are still blocked from setHeroBackground/clearHeroBackground, setVideo/clearVideo, and setBackgroundSong/clearBackgroundSong with clear authorization errors.
Existing allowlist management APIs (getImageUploaderAllowlist/grant/revoke/hasImageUploaderAccess) may remain, but they no longer restrict image publishing/clearing.

requirements.text: Update frontend Media Manager permissions logic so that the Images tab is editable for all visitors (anyone), while Hero/Videos/Song remain restricted to administrators. Ensure any user-facing permission/lock text is in English and matches the new behavior.

quotes: Give the access to anyone that they can add their images in this website through their phone gallery or Google drive

acceptanceCriteria: When not an admin, the Media Manager still shows lock messaging for Hero/Videos/Song, but the Images tab allows Upload/Replace/Adjust/Clear/Reorder and Submit.
The Images tab no longer shows 'Administrator or image uploader access required' for non-admin users.
The submit flow in non-admin mode publishes only image-related changes (no hero/video/song actions attempted), and errors (if any) are shown in English without closing the dialog.

requirements.text: Update Media Manager UI copy to explicitly tell users they can choose images from their phone gallery or Google Drive via the device file picker (no separate Google Drive login).

quotes: through their phone gallery or Google drive

acceptanceCriteria: Media Manager includes a short, clear English instruction near image uploading controls, e.g., indicating that the upload picker may offer 'Photos' or 'Google Drive' depending on the device.
No UI implies a Google Drive OAuth/login integration or requires connecting a Drive account inside the app.

constraints: Respect the single-actor Motoko backend architecture; keep logic changes in backend/main.mo.
Do not edit any frontend files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
All user-facing text must be in English.
Do not add third-party authentication or Google Drive API/OAuth integration; rely on the device/system file picker for Drive selection.
nonGoals: Adding a full Google Drive integration (OAuth, browsing Drive inside the app, Drive API calls).
Changing admin-only permissions for Hero background, Video Memories, or Background Song.
Introducing new backend services, databases, or multi-canister architecture.
